items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Willie's daughter was teaching at the time, Willie Humphress.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I don't see why they don't use it.

You take, well, I mean, a school band, we have a school band at the Fifth Ward, and the, the superintendent, and the, well, we, I'm, I'm, well, they say good friend. We, I always do the, all the, the mechanic work, tractors and car, and then I begin to work in school, teaching for the school. Well, he asked me about the band, so I told him, I said, the band is not doing too good. He said, well, what's the trouble? I said, well, the boys that, that have music in him don't have the money to buy an instrument and…
